stage1.impression: A clean, competent real-time-looking render of an empty shop seen through a window, not a photograph: the floor is a flat, evenly lit grey plane brighter than the hero, the walls and drapes are smooth and untextured, there are no reflections in the shopfront glass, and the room has no sign of life. The Ember pair reads at a glance as red acrylic boxes, but their faces are dark and murky. The tinted pendants and the coloured cards on the left wall pull the eye away from them. A design magazine would not run it as a specific place: it reads as a generic, showroom-empty retail unit.

blocking_9: The window pair is the brightest, most legible thing in the frame: speaker regions lum_median >= 45, with the light through the acrylic glowing at the edges and the woofers' faces readable
The floor falls off into pools under the spots instead of a uniform wash: floor band lum_median <= 55 and lum_range >= 100
The shopfront glass shows faint, believable reflections of the street (the lamp, the building opposite), so the frame reads as taken from the sidewalk through glass
Concrete floor, plaster and felt show real texture at 1:1 (pour marks, trowel variation, felt nap), not smooth CG planes
Signs of life and specificity: records out of sleeves on the table, glasses on the bar and the high table, a coat or bag, a handwritten card, so it is a particular shop on a particular night
The bottom 10 % of the frame (sill/plinth foreground) holds detail instead of being 67 % crushed

defects.what: Left Tropos is underlit for a hero: lum_median 25.4, cabinet front muddy dark red, woofer surround reads flat; the horn's mouth is a black blob
Right Tropos darker still: lum_median 18.4, crush 12 %
Floor is the brightest large area in the frame (lum_median 89.5, r 113), a uniform, untextured wash that reads as CG and outshines the speakers
Foreground sill band is 66.8 % crushed across 10 % of the frame: a dead black bar
Saturated blue/yellow cards on the left wall add a second colour story
Hemisphere pendants in cyan, violet and peach compete with the Ember pair (fixed products; their glow level can still drop)
No reflections or glare on the shopfront glass; the frame doesn't read as taken through a window from the street
Drapes and plaster are smooth, evenly lit and textureless; the felt wash is a flat column of light without a gradient
Table and bar empty: no records, glasses or props; the room is showroom-empty
High table with two glass globes reads as a placeholder; little else in the mid-ground
Ceiling and beam are a flat dark band with no detail or fixtures

changes.problem: The hero pair is darker than the floor and walls behind it, so it doesn't stop a passer-by.

evidence.measured: lum_median 25.4 (right speaker 18.4) vs floor band 89.5; target >= 45

change.to: 2 x 140 W, 2600 K, cone 22 deg, aimed slightly from above and in front so light passes through the acrylic and rakes the cabinet edges

changes.expected: Cabinets glow ember-red with bright polished edges; woofer cones readable; each speaker's region lum_median ~50-60

changes.problem: The floor is a uniform bright wash that flattens the room and outshines the speakers.

evidence.measured: lum_median 89.5, r_median 113, lum_p5 10 — almost evenly lit

change.setting: soft light: the room's fill; render exposure
change.to: fill 0.05 W/m2, exposure 3.6 (compensate the hero with c1)

changes.expected: The floor drops into pools under the spots with dark between; the speakers become the brightest thing

changes.problem: Concrete floor and plaster read as smooth CG planes with an even sheen.

evidence.measured: visual at 1:1: no pour lines, trowel marks or wear; even specular

change.setting: materials: the floor's tone and sheen, the plaster's tone
change.from: floor scan tinted #4E4943, uniform sheen; plaster #BDB4A6 flat
change.to: floor #3E3A35 with a roughness map varying 0.35-0.7 (scuffed paths, sealer patches); plaster #A89F92 with a low-frequency trowel bump and tonal mottling

changes.expected: Spot pools on the floor break up into a believable sealed-concrete sheen; walls read as hand-finished plaster

changes.problem: The shop is empty and generic; nothing says it's a particular place, open tonight.

evidence.measured: visual: table and bar bare, no records out, no glasses

change.to: a few records leaning and one out of its sleeve on the table, two wine glasses and a carafe on the bar, two half-full glasses and a folded card on the high table, a coat over a stool, a chalkboard or hand-lettered price card by the shelves

changes.expected: The frame reads as a specific shop mid-evening; small highlights on glass under 2700 K

changes.problem: The tinted pendants and coloured wall cards break the one-colour rule and pull the eye up and left.

evidence.measured: visual: saturated blue and yellow cards; pendants cyan/violet/peach at frame top

change.setting: EARF's lamps: each Hemisphere; small props (cards)
change.from: Hemisphere 4.0 W, glow 0.012; coloured cards on the left wall
change.to: Hemisphere 2.0 W, glow 0.006; replace the cards with neutral black-and-white prints or remove them

changes.expected: Pendants become small accents; the Ember pair is the only strong colour

changes.problem: The frame lacks the shopfront glass that the brief says it's seen through.

evidence.measured: visual: no reflection, glare or dust on glass anywhere

change.setting: street lamp outside; outside: building opposite's lit windows
change.to: street lamp 0.4 W/m2, 2200 K; 0.3 of the windows opposite lit; glass with ~4 % reflectance so faint warm reflections of the street sit over the dark top corners and ceiling

changes.expected: Faint ghosted reflections in the upper dark areas; the frame reads as through-the-window

changes.problem: The foreground sill/plinth is a dead black bar.

change.setting: street lamp outside (spill on the sill) and plinth top
change.to: raised per c6 so the sill picks up a warm edge; lift lum_p5 in post with a gentle toe

changes.expected: The sill reads as a surface with an edge highlight and red spill from the speakers

changes.problem: The back felt is evenly lit and textureless; there's no atmosphere between front and back.

evidence.measured: lum_median 38.2, flat wash column; haze 0.002 invisible

change.to: 1.0 W/m2 grazing from the top so the folds read with a top-to-bottom falloff; haze 0.006

changes.expected: Drapes show fold shadows and fall off downward; a faint veil of haze in spot beams adds depth

out_of_scope.request: Hemisphere pendants in a single neutral tint
out_of_scope.why: The products' tints are fixed; only their glow level can change (c5)

out_of_scope.request: Show the horn's throat as a lighter shape instead of a black hole
out_of_scope.why: The horn's resin and shape are the product's; only light can help

out_of_scope.request: Fill the large empty floor between window and bar with furniture
out_of_scope.why: The plan (A-401) fixes what stands where
